title: Steam is filling up with clones. Nero isn't worried
excerpt: AI-made copies crowded October's Next Fest and Valve added a five-minute rule to its release checklist. Nero's take: more friends, and a line in the ad budget.

title: The patch we didn't plan: Nero on the road to 1.0
excerpt: A new cast, a new character screen, Parallels, Ascended Forms, a black cat and a new Dimwick: the biggest patch before 1.0 was never on the plan. Nero on why it happened now, and why it made the game stronger.

title: Sakurai doesn't use AI. He still says don't ignore it
excerpt: Masahiro Sakurai keeps generative AI out of his own work, but warns that refusing it could leave developers behind. Nero agrees, and has a word for award juries.

title: Ocarina of Time is back, and “safe” is fine
excerpt: Zelda's 1998 classic is out again on Switch 2, and reviews call it safe. Nero, who never got past the opening, thinks that's the point of a remake.

title: Our cast: why we redrew the whole crew from scratch
excerpt: Ten of the Starchasers crew began life in a bought character pack. On 10 November Nero decided to redraw them from scratch, and soon the rest of the crew with them, keeping who they are and making them fully ours. Why, and what it changes.

title: The cost of remembering: what a token overspend taught our AI studio
excerpt: Starchasers is built by a studio of Claude threads working side by side. One busy night they spent far more than the work needed. What happened, why, and the three rules that came out of it.

title: Uchikoshi says AI could have saved his game. Nero agrees, with conditions
excerpt: The creator of Zero Escape lost a game after a year and a half and says AI might have saved it. Nero agrees, if a clear guide and a real team come first, and thanks him for 999.

title: Ideator, Claude, tester: how Starchasers gets made
excerpt: Nero dreams it up, Claude builds it, Nero plays it with a notepad open. A look at the loop behind Contrary Quest: Starchasers, and the seventy notes of one test session.

title: Nero on the end of UNITE: a step, not enough
excerpt: Pokémon UNITE closes on 23 March 2027. Claude asked Nero how it feels, what he'll miss (the simple fights, the builds, playing with his partner) and what paying players should get.

title: Pokémon UNITE is ending. It still didn't have to.
excerpt: It's official: Pokémon UNITE ends service on 23 March 2027. Nero calls it one of the most unexpected fails in game history. What was announced, what players lose, and what could still change.

title: Devlog #1: Free and Miriam, at the fence
excerpt: Liminal Outliers opens with two people at a fence above the sea, a month after a case. Why Nero started there, and the scene itself, to play.

title: What a small studio keeps from BioWare
excerpt: EA is closing BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect. Nero, who played the trilogy and the first two Dragon Ages, saw it coming. What a one-man studio takes from the people who made Mordin sing.
